lines.text: Woke up to the sunlight kissing my face
Yesterday’s worries slowly fade away
Little things reminding me I’m not alone
In the quiet moments, love has always shown
When the world feels heavy, I remember this
Every breath, every smile is a gift
Small miracles all around me every day
In your eyes, in the sky, in the words you say
They lift me higher, they light the way
Small miracles, carrying me through today
Coffee with a friend, laughter in the air
Random acts of kindness everywhere
I used to miss them chasing bigger dreams
Now I see the magic in the in-between
When the world feels heavy, I remember this
Every breath, every smile is a gift
Small miracles all around me every day
In your eyes, in the sky, in the words you say
They lift me higher, they light the way
Small miracles, carrying me through today
Grateful for the little lights that guide me home
Small miracles all around me every day
In your eyes, in the sky, in the words you say
They lift me higher, they light the way
Small miracles, carrying me through today
